label: Eliezer

text.BHSA EZR 10:17: וַיְכַלּ֣וּ בַכֹּ֔ל אֲנָשִׁ֕ים הַהֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיֹּ֑ות עַ֛ד יֹ֥ום אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֹֽׁון׃ פ
text.KJV EZR 10:17: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
text.BHSA EZR 10:18: וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיֹּ֑ות מִבְּנֵי֙ יֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־יֹֽוצָדָק֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֔זֶר וְיָרִ֖יב וּגְדַלְיָֽה׃
text.KJV EZR 10:18: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
text.BHSA EZR 10:19: וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ יָדָ֖ם לְהֹוצִ֣יא נְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֵׁמִ֥ים אֵֽיל־צֹ֖אן עַל־אַשְׁמָתָֽם׃ ס
text.KJV EZR 10:19: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.

A.name: Eliezer
A.line: Priest Ezra sent to Iddo (EZR 8:16), married a foreign wife (EZR 10:18, EZ 10:23)
family: descendant-of jeshua-3 (Jeshua, returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (EZR 2:2, N)
descendant-of levi (Levi, third-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:34), son of Leah)

B.name: Eliezer
B.line: Priest, of the sons of Jeshua's family, who had married a foreign wife.
family: descendant-of jeshua-3 (Jeshua, returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (EZR 2:2, N)

why: The Hebrew names one Eliezer among the priests of Jeshua son of Jozadak’s family who married foreign wives. B matches this description, but A states the same office, ancestry, and event, so the supplied facts do not distinguish them; choosing B is tentative.
